speaker: Abhinavagupta (devotee voice, addressing heart)
question: O heart, what now?
premises: By varied birth-wandering gears, omniscience gained — O heart — effortlessly by You.
That within, in teaching-spread-course-become light: clearly in speech obtained — show the Lord's hymn now.
inference: Omniscience gained effortlessly; heart bidden to show the hymn in speech.
